requirements: Is there exactly one single painting of Boppy?
Is Boppy shown full body from head to shoes?
Is Boppy standing and alone in the image?
Is Boppy facing the viewer at a slight three-quarter angle?
Is Boppy in the exact unimpressed pose: leaning on one hip with one hand on the hip?
Are Boppy's eyes half closed and his mouth turned down?
Is Boppy's fishing rod over his shoulder?
Is the thick white mustache clearly visible on Boppy?
Does the figure fill about 85 percent of the picture height and is it centered?
Is there an even empty margin all around the figure?
